revelations.name: Gift of Life
revelations.stage_zero_description:

In addition, all your spell cooldowns are reduced by 60 seconds, and  20% / 25% / 30%  of your maximum mana is restored.  
Cooldown:  30h / 20h / 10h  
The cooldown is only reduced while the character has a battle sign.
